review.why: Scores and rewrites a LinkedIn profile with bundled audit scripts, worksheet and references.
review.summary: Audits a LinkedIn profile section by section, scores the headline, ranks fixes by points per hour and builds the About section using three Python scripts, a worksheet, an example input and reference notes.
strengths: Ordered workflow with exit-code stop conditions
Three scripts plus worksheet and example input
cautions: Scripts must be read before trusting

notes: Instructs running local Python scripts on user-provided profile data; review scripts before running.
